name: KILNWORKS
desc: A rotationally symmetric brickworks built around a three-storey Furnace Hall: rail cuts on the flanks, sheds and lofts in between, and a fight for the furnace top.

areas.name: Clay Yard
areas.hint: Exits: north to Pump Lane, east to the Rail Cut

areas.name: Furnace Hall
areas.hint: Centre: the furnace blocks every door-to-door line

areas.name: Furnace Top
areas.hint: 3rd level — open to the whole mezzanine
